ACME Q2 2026 Earnings Call

Operator: Welcome to the quarterly earnings call. Management will discuss business operations, customer demand, overseas capacity expansion and the revenue outlook with financial analysts. We will then take questions from investors.

Prepared Remarks

CFO: Subscription revenue grew 18% to $1.2 billion and advertising revenue increased 20% in the quarter, driven by demand across every region.

CEO: We raised the full year outlook for cash flow and expect the margin structure to remain stable through the second half.

  • Customer demand remained strong across enterprise accounts.
  • Overseas capacity expansion continues on schedule this year.

Analyst: Can you talk about the advertising pricing trend this quarter?

CFO: Advertising revenue growth was 20 points and pricing stabilized, which is what we expected given the mix shift we described earlier.
